Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Arik Klingensmith <ar...@thepad.ebay.sun.com> wrote:
>At what phase of combat do you play "Concealed Weapon" and does
>it count for your play at that phase.

Concealed Weapon would be used as a round begins (card text). It doesn't
count as a strike or anything, so wouldn't interfere at all with your
ability to play other cards during the round.
